meaning: Native pre-tip centers on the exact old observed prefix. No manual axis/labels enter the estimator, no new seeds, no tip relocation or product effect. An available center/axis does not certify same-fiber identity or a true endpoint.
searchBound: Normal projection of a half analysis-pixel box: .5*(abs(nx)*sourcePerAnalysisX+abs(ny)*sourcePerAnalysisY); round DOWN to the .25px search lattice. Reject a maximum on its boundary. A sampling-cell bound is not a calibrated uncertainty interval.
fitPolicy: Unweighted total least-squares on every accepted pre-tip sample in each window. No tip anchor in the fit. At least3samples and no missing/rejected sample; otherwise no axis. Both margins and all windows reported; never select a favorable configuration. Coherence/residual/axis disagreement remain diagnostics, not calibrated acceptance probabilities.
inheritedChecks: Valley floor, competing-peak ratio/separation and bounded parabolic interpolation follow the preceding native-center experiment. No per-case threshold or interval fitting after observation.
